title: Chapter 44: The Restoration of All Things: The Dispensation of the Fulness of Times
book: Teachings of Presidents of the Church: Joseph Smith
author: Joseph Smith

footnotes.text: Quoted by Martha Jane Knowlton Coray, reporting a discourse given by Joseph Smith in Nauvoo, Illinois; Martha Jane Knowlton Coray, Notebook, Church Archives, The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, Salt Lake City, Utah; this discourse is dated July 19, 1840, in Sister Coray’s notebook, but the discourse was probably given at a later date.
